title: Ananias companion of Daniel
summary: Raleigh names Ananias companion of Daniel in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ananias, taken with Daniel, Misael, and Azarias for a pledge, when Nabuchodonosor forced Ierusalem in the third yeere of Iehoiakim. He is not Ananias the false Prophet. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVIII, §. VI, sig. 377b–378a
